description: Electricity Market Dataset across Regions, published by Roy, Millend; Pyltsov, Vladimir; Capponi, Agostino, harmonizes electricity-price and consumption series across five markets. Coverage: New York, California, Texas, Germany and Italy; source time zones and units remain market-specific. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Local daylight-saving time and physical units differ between markets. Numerically similar hourly MW and MWh values retain different meanings. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
